I think you've done a great job in research and explaining all the difficulties that one encounters in the UK and US.

A CEX's basically mostly needed for on/off-ramp and maybe for more elaborate trading strategies. For an exchange between tokens that live on different blockchains, atomic swap can be the alternative. It's an order book, so it's not instant swapping. 

I point out once more to integrate the atomic swap pallet in one of the next upgrades. It can also be deployed as smart contract on either VM's, Drew coded one once. But best choice would be the pallet, it's really simple.

[Acuity](https://acuity.social/blog) Dex is in its testing phase and on 8 testnets. It will support a whopping 46 chains and rollups, among them even ETC and BCHsmart. Mostly done via EVM-smart contracts. I haven't tried it out yet, but the concept's really simple.

https://acuity.social/atomic-swap

With DEXs and especially atomic swap based exchanges, we can actually move quicker...
